scraped.scraped_description: A rich, crowdsourced collection of thousands of tech for good projects from around the world.

name: Civic Tech Field Guide
tagline: The world's largest collection of projects using tech for the common good
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: Reliance on volunteer contributions and grant funding; potential sustainability challenges if major funders withdraw support
news_articles: TechCrunch coverage of civic tech landscape
Guardian articles on civic technology initiatives
academic_citations: Citations in civic tech and digital democracy research literature
awards: Recognition as leading civic tech resource
documented_limitations: Curation bias toward English-language and Western-focused projects
Limited representation of projects from Global South
Ongoing challenge to maintain accuracy of project information
failure_modes: Outdated project information if not regularly maintained
Potential for incomplete coverage of emerging civic tech initiatives
curation_criteria: Carefully curated categories across tech, people, ethical tech, and more
contributor_governance: Community contributions reviewed by core team; transparent submission process
disparity_tracking: Tracks representation of projects from diverse geographies and communities

government_partnerships.nature: Resource consultation for youth empowerment initiatives

political_relevance_summary: Addresses barriers to meaningful citizen participation in democratic decision-making by providing tools for public engagement and deliberation.

movement_building_utility.notes: Serves as an information resource for civic actors, researchers, or the public.

generalizability_notes: Already deployed across multiple jurisdictions (multiple countries), demonstrating cross-context adaptability. Methodology and approach could inform similar efforts in other jurisdictions.
